paragraphs.text: I started coding five years ago as a hobby — teaching myself to build a friend's website on weekends, just to see if I could make it better. I could.

Somewhere along the way I fell in love with the craft itself: solving problems, building clean interfaces, and architecting systems that just work. What started as a favour for a friend turned into a full-time career.
What makes me different is that I don't just write code — I build products that solve real problems and are built to last.
My mission is simple: help businesses turn ideas into fast, reliable, well-built web products that actually grow their audience.
